title: Hidden in the Shadow of Your Wings

questions.question: Hear a just cause, O Lord; attend to my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:1 (ESV): "Hear a just cause, O Lord; attend to my cry!"

questions.question: Give ear to my prayer from lips free of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:1 (ESV): "...give ear to my prayer from lips free of deceit!"

questions.question: You have tried my heart, you have visited me when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:3 (ESV): "You have tried my heart, you have visited me by night;"

questions.question: Keep me as the apple of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:8 (ESV): "Keep me as the apple of your eye;"

questions.question: Hide me in the shadow of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:8 (ESV): "...hide me in the shadow of your wings,"

questions.question: As for me, I shall behold your face in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:15 (ESV): "As for me, I shall behold your face in righteousness;"

questions.question: When I awake, I shall be satisfied with your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:15 (ESV): "...when I awake, I shall be satisfied with your likeness."

questions.question: They close their hearts to pity; with their mouths they speak how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:10 (ESV): "They close their hearts to pity; with their mouths they speak arrogantly."

questions.question: He is like a lion eager to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:12 (ESV): "He is like a lion eager to tear, as a young lion lurking in ambush."

questions.question: Arise, O Lord! Confront him, subdue him! Deliver my soul from the wicked by your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:13 (ESV): "Arise, O Lord! Confront him, subdue him! Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,"

questions.question: My steps have held fast to your paths; my feet have not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:5 (ESV): "My steps have held fast to your paths; my feet have not slipped."

questions.question: I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God; incline your what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:6 (ESV): "I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God; incline your ear to me; hear my words."

questions.question: Wondrously show your steadfast love, O Savior of those who seek refuge from their adversaries at your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:7 (ESV): "...O Savior of those who seek refuge from their adversaries at your right hand."

questions.question: From men by your hand, O Lord, from men of the world whose portion is in this what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:14 (ESV): "from men by your hand, O Lord, from men of the world whose portion is in this life."

questions.question: You fill their womb with treasure; they are satisfied with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 17:14 (ESV): "...they are satisfied with children, and they leave their abundance to their infants."

key_verse_text: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings,
